 Celebs bid adieu to Maa Durga in festive style in Mumbai
 As people bid farewell to Maa Durga on Dussehra, Mumbai witnessed a star-studded gathering with celebrities embracing the occasion in vibrant ethnic wear.
 Published on: Oct 21, 2026, 16:26:21 IST By HT Correspondent Prefer HT on Google Share via 
 Copy link 
 Dussehra brought the Durga Puja festivities to a close on October 20, with Bollywood celebrities gathering in Mumbai to bid farewell to Maa Durga. From vibrant leheriya and Banarasi sarees to statement kurtas, the stars embraced traditional festive dressing, while Soha Ali Khan added to the celebrations with a dhunuchi dance.
 (L-R) Actor Soha Ali Khan and filmmaker Karan Johar at North Bombay Sarbojanin Durga Puja Here’s a look at the celebrity style and moments from the farewell.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Soha (@sakpataudi) 
 Actor Soha Ali Khan performed the traditional dhunuchi dance in an orange saree with gold motifs.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Karan Johar (@karanjohar) 
 Filmmaker Karan Johar arrived with his children Yash and Roohi in a printed pink kurta set, paired with a Bandhej dupatta.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Vishal Mohan Jaiswal (@vmj_bollywood) 
 The Mukerji sisters kept it traditional. Kajol opted for a pink and orange ombre saree, while Tanishaa wore a white saree with gold motifs.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bollywood Five (@bollywoodfive) 
 Actor Juhi Chawla Mehta wore a vibrant pink leheriya ensemble with gota patti details.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by yogen shah (@yogenshah_s) 
 Designer Manish Malhotra kept it dapper in a black kurta with pink trims, while filmmaker Ayan Mukerji opted for a patterned kurta.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by B-Town Life (@b.town.life) 
 Actor Neelam Kothari opted for a bright yellow Bandhej suit, while her friend, designer Seema Sajdeh wore an ivory Banarasi saree.
